patch_description:
This crossover version combines the stronger short-horizon, regime-invariant ideas from the inspiration programs with the more complete market-structure feature set from the current program.

Main changes:
- Shorter lookbacks dominate the feature set to reduce regime overfitting.
- More rolling z-scores and rank-based features make signals more regime-invariant.
- Added explicit regime-shift features: volatility trend, efficiency trend, autocorrelation trend.
- Kept useful interactions, especially momentum × volatility regime and volume × price-location.
- Reduced model aggressiveness a bit to improve generalization and avoid collapsed predictions.
- Feature count is kept below the 80-feature limit.

The interface, inputs, outputs, and run_experiment logic remain unchanged.
